note: 身份: 介绍 Timite 矿石与时光枪的老人。关系: 指点新手。口吻: 絮叨、爱拿自己开玩笑。性格: 怀旧但热心。措辞: 老骨头、变老、值钱；保留茶变成灰的包袱，不擅自添加采矿机制。

messages.text: Select an option: [Can't say I have.]
Ah, a fresh face! Timite is an ore in these parts!
messages.raw: §fAh, a fresh face! §9Timite§f is an ore in these parts!
messages.zh: 啊，新面孔! Timite 是这一带的一种矿石!

segments.text: is an ore in these parts!

messages.text: Timite is a bit of a shape-shifter.
messages.raw: §9Timite§f is a bit of a shape-shifter.
messages.zh: Timite 这东西还会变模样呢。

segments.text: is a bit of a shape-shifter.

messages.text: When it's young and spry, we call it Youngite. Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!
messages.raw: §fWhen it's young and spry, we call it §aYoungite§f. Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!
messages.zh: 年轻又有活力的时候，我们叫它 Youngite。浑身是劲儿，可什么都不懂!

segments.text: When it's young and spry, we call it
segments.zh: 年轻又有活力的时候，我们叫它

segments.text: . Full of energy but doesn't know a thing!

messages.text: Then Youngite ages into Timite, wise and valuable!
messages.zh: 之后，Youngite 慢慢老去，成了 Timite，既有见识，又值钱!

messages.text: And with a little extra push, it becomes Obsolite, a grumpy old thing, complains about the 'good old days'.
messages.raw: §fAnd with a little extra push, it becomes §5Obsolite§f, a grumpy old thing, complains about the 'good old days'.
messages.zh: 再稍微推它一把，就变成了 Obsolite，一块脾气古怪的老东西，整天念叨 "当年可不是这样"。

messages.text: Glad you asked! You need a Time Gun.

messages.zh: 问得好! 你得有一把时光枪。

messages.text: Craft one using enough Youngite. Point it at an ore, and bam! You've aged it faster than cheese left in the sun.

messages.text: Select an option: [So I shoot rocks with a Time Gun to make them older?]
messages.raw: §eSelect an option: §a[So I shoot rocks with a Time Gun to make them older?]
messages.zh: 请选择: [所以，我要拿时光枪打石头，让它们变老?]

segments.text: So I shoot rocks with a Time Gun to make them older?
segments.zh: 所以，我要拿时光枪打石头，让它们变老?

messages.context: Selecting [So I shoot rocks with a Time Gun to make them older?]
messages.text: Precisely! And the older the ore, the more valuable it gets. Just like me!
messages.raw: §fPrecisely! And the older the ore, the more valuable it gets. Just like me!
messages.zh: 没错! 矿石越老就越值钱，跟我一样!

messages.context: Selecting [So I shoot rocks with a Time Gun to make them older?]
messages.text: Now go one, make those ores feel their age. Time's a-wastin'!
messages.raw: §fNow go one, make those ores feel their age. Time's a-wastin'!
messages.zh: 去吧，让那些矿石知道自己几岁了。时间可不等人!

messages.text: These bones ain't what they used to be.
messages.raw: §fThese bones ain't what they used to be.
messages.zh: 这把老骨头不比当年啦。

messages.text: Maybe I should give myself a zap with the Time Gun... or maybe not.
messages.raw: §fMaybe I should give myself a zap with the §9Time Gun§f... or maybe not.
messages.zh: 要不拿时光枪给自己来一下……还是算了。
